words.example: The holiday-roster motion was carried with no further changes.
words.exampleZh: 假期排班那项动议原案通过，没有再作修改。

words.example: The idea of opening a Saturday clinic was defeated.
words.exampleZh: 开设周六门诊的提议未通过。

words.example: The vote to adopt the new visitor rules was unanimous.
words.exampleZh: 采用新访客规定的表决是一致通过的。

words.example: A clear majority wanted to keep the counters open at the current hours.
words.exampleZh: 明显的多数希望柜台继续按现在的时间开放。

words.example: Please capture the minority view in the minutes, not only the result.
words.exampleZh: 请在纪要里记下少数意见，不要只写表决结果。

words.example: Shadow IT grew when clinics bought their own chat tool and stored patient names there.
words.exampleZh: 门诊自己买了聊天工具，还把患者姓名存在里面，影子信息化就是这样长出来的。

words.example: An unsanctioned app on the ward tablet was syncing schedules to a personal cloud.
words.exampleZh: 病区平板上有个未批准软件，正在把排班同步到个人云。

words.example: The software whitelist blocked the new viewer until we approved its publisher.
words.exampleZh: 在我们批准发布者之前，软件白名单拦住了新的阅片程序。

words.example: The software inventory shows three clinic PCs still running the retired viewer.
words.exampleZh: 软件清单显示还有三台门诊电脑在跑已经退役的阅片程序。

words.example: The license count for the viewer is short by twelve seats this quarter.
words.exampleZh: 这个季度阅片软件的授权数量少了十二个席位。
